mapper.sql: q.*, c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS owner_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question f WHERE f.parent_id=q.id AND f.status=1) AS follow_up_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question f WHERE f.parent_id=q.id AND f.status=1) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_follow_up
FROM question q LEFT JOIN question_category c ON c.id=q.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=q.owner_id
